reference.reference_binary: CE1-C exact recorded binary64 E0, c2,ct,c4 and reference shear sx,sy

geometry.energy_pressure: 8*pi*G*Tstar^2/c^2 multiplied by physical energy density and pressure

kinetic.state: entire continuum angular distribution; no multipole truncation in physical model
kinetic.constraints: positive initial angular polynomial; every initial directional expansion nonnegative; Hamiltonian constraint exact reference at t=0

inputs.type: rational decimal string center/radius boxes; exact stored binary64 reference

math.source_difference: sup_ell>=0 |P_i(E,c;ell)-P_i(E0,c0;ell)| <= dE + Emax*(2/5 dc2 + 4/9 dct + 1/3 dc4)
math.comparison: x_prime<=y; y_prime<=4Emax*x+eta; initial y0 bounded by interval Hamiltonian root
math.addition: CE1-C nominal path upper + CE1-D input-to-nominal exact-solution upper (triangle inequality)
math.evaluation: MPFR192 RNDD/RNDU via existing CE1-C Interval and exact Fraction physical endpoints

limitations: not an enclosure for arbitrary nonpolynomial angular data
physical acquisition uncertainty must actually lie in declared box
not a formal verification of Python/MPFR binding or parent mathematics
not a generic contracting Bianchi estimate
